faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Cash, all major credit and debit cards, and bank transfer. Payment plans are available for treatments over $500.

faqs.q: I have a toothache or dental emergency. What should I do?
faqs.a: Call us right away or book an emergency visit; we keep same-day slots free. If you have severe swelling affecting your breathing or swallowing, or heavy bleeding that will not stop, go to the nearest emergency room.
